sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the earlier repairs: remove the remaining unconditional ship-level nltl:allowableShearStress property constraint, because it makes the property mandatory when beamTheoryUsed is false. Rebuild sh:or using two node-shape branches that target the ship itself: the true branch must require beamTheoryUsed=true and allowableShearStress, and the false branch must require beamTheoryUsed=false. The current nested sh:property structure is attached to the boolean property shape and therefore targets the boolean value rather than the ship. Retain the verified MegaPA unit, von Mises hasValue, strict combined-stress comparison, and expected-result-scaled arithmetic tolerance.
